description: Source code for drawing Bezier curves in text mode, including screen initialization, drawing curves, marking directions, and outputting the screen buffer.

methods.name: fmin
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two double values.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of an integer.

methods.name: initscreen
methods.description: Initializes the text mode screen buffer with given physical dimensions and drawable area parameters.

methods.name: drawcurve
methods.description: Draws a Bezier curve in text mode based on control points.

methods.name: drawcurvedir
methods.description: Draws a Bezier curve with direction markers at the ends.

methods.name: drawdot
methods.description: Marks a point on the screen buffer.

methods.name: setabsdot
methods.description: Sets a mark at specific absolute coordinates in the buffer.

methods.name: setfdot
methods.description: Sets a mark at a floating-point coordinate after scaling.

methods.name: printscreen
methods.description: Outputs the current screen buffer to a file.
